definitions.explanation: Providing financial or material support for an event, project, or cause. Often seen in the context of corporate sponsorship of events, festivals, or media productions.

examples.japanese: {協賛|きょうさん}{企業|きぎょう}を{募集|ぼしゅう}する。
このイベントは{大手|おおて}{企業|きぎょう}の{協賛|きょうさん}で{開催|かいさい}される。
examples.english: This event is held with the sponsorship of major corporations.

examples.japanese: {地元|じもと}の{商店街|しょうてんがい}が{祭|まつ}りに{協賛|きょうさん}して、{飲|の}み{物|もの}を{提供|ていきょう}した。
examples.english: The local shopping district sponsored the festival and provided drinks.

notes: Composed of {協|きょう} (cooperate) + {賛|さん} (approve/support). Common collocations: {協賛|きょうさん}{企業|きぎょう} (sponsoring company), {協賛|きょうさん}{金|きん} (sponsorship fee), {協賛|きょうさん}する (to sponsor). Often seen in event credits: {主催|しゅさい} (organizer), {後援|こうえん} (endorsement), {協賛|きょうさん} (sponsor).
